messages:
julia: Dropped a consolidated benchmark narrative and a lightweight hero kit into Drive. Need a clear winner for headline, hero stat, and what to gate behind the whitepaper. Goal: PLG-friendly launch with an enterprise capture funnel.

max: Quick read. For PLG hero pick median(128) latency and a small cost-per-1k token badge. Keep hero copy short. Blog can show CDF + annotated scatter for recommended configs.

anita: Agree. Also recommend an explicit methodology footnote in the blog that lists model versions, GPU types, quantization, batch sizes and the test harness. Link to raw CSVs.

paul: For enterprise gating: require company size and expected monthly tokens on the form. If company_size >= 100 OR expected_monthly_tokens >= 15M OR checkbox private_deploy=true -> tag Enterprise-fit and webhook AE. Also capture 'need_SLA' boolean.

yuri: Visuals: hero = single metric with delta badge (e.g., "+30% faster (median)") and small secondary stats p95 + cost/1k. Blog panels = CDF (log x optional), cost vs latency scatter with pareto frontier annotation, and a tiny waterfall breaking down cost components.

julia: Great. Copy variants please: PLG headline short & long, Enterprise headline, and 2 CTA suggestions (Try API vs Request demo/Whitepaper).

max: Drafts: PLG short: "Fast inference. Predictable cost." PLG long: "Low-latency inference that scales affordably for developer teams." Enterprise: "Predictable latency and economics for production LLMs." CTAs: Try API / Request whitepaper.

anita: Legal note: use conservative language: "up to 1.7x lower per-token cost on short chat sequences; results vary by model and config. See paper for test harness." Call out baseline model in footnote.

paul: For analytics: track events bench_page_view, bench_whitepaper_request, bench_try_api_click. Add properties on leads: company_size_bucket, expected_monthly_tokens_bucket, private_deploy_interest.

yuri: Accessibility: colorblind-safe palette, patterns on scatter groups, alt text for charts, and ensure delta badges include text not only color.

julia: Webinar idea: 40min tech talk + 20min Q&A titled "Serving LLMs: practical tradeoffs between latency and cost." Offer whitepaper as gated follow-up. Promo plan: 30/14/7/2 day cadence.

max: I'll produce hero comps + small stats table and a hero copy deck by EOD tomorrow.

anita: I'll write the methodology card and prepare the raw CSVs & a reproducibility appendix for the whitepaper.

paul: I'll build the HubSpot form & automation and the AE webhook rule. Will include UTM capture and set scoring rule for Enterprise-fit.

yuri: I'll mock the blog panels (CDF + scatter + waterfall) and annotate the pareto points and recommended config callouts.

whitepaper-bot: [system] file uploaded: /shared/marketing/bench/resources/bench-summary-2026-03-24.pdf by julia at 2026-03-24T11:05:10Z

julia: Thanks. Quick decisions for this thread: PLG hero = median(128); Enterprise hero = p95 in the small stats table; whitepaper gated behind form; webinar two weeks post-publish. Anyone disagree?

max: No objections. Locking those.

anita: LGTM. I'll make sure the whitepaper has the reproducibility scripts.

paul: Will add AE routing for Enterprise-fit and a Slack webhook. ETA 48 hours after comps locked.

yuri: Will handoff assets to frontend for the tiny interactive slider if they want it. Need CSV endpoint with CORS.

julia: Awesome  I'll consolidate and push a draft launch checklist. Ping here for sign-off once assets are in Drive.
